title: WorkloadStatus
description: A knowledge base's operational readings from Collector metrics. Request-tracking occupancy and queue depth are current gauges; completed and failed are worker counters since that worker process started. Missing readings are unknown, never zero.

ledger.description: The Gateway's request tracking: correlation IDs it currently holds so replies can be routed to the app client that sent each request, and the tracking capacity.

claims.description: Number of request IDs currently held to route replies to their requesting app clients. Includes requests still waiting for a reply and recently answered requests still within the tracking window.

capacity.description: The maximum number of IDs held in this Gateway's local tracking projection.

queue.description: Current Dispatcher depth and, when the worker has emitted counters, completed and failed work since worker start. These are different measurements and time windows.

pending.description: Jobs currently waiting for a worker.

failed.description: Jobs finally failed since worker start.
